title: The Luteal Phase
content: The luteal phase occurs after ovulation and before a period begins, typically lasting 11-17 days. The empty follicle that released the egg becomes a structure called the corpus luteum, which secretes progesterone. Progesterone thickens the uterine lining. If a fertilized egg doesn't implant, the corpus luteum breaks down, progesterone levels drop, and the uterine lining sheds (menstruation).
